issueTypes.name: Electrical & Power Systems
issueTypes.description: Main switchgear, wiring, high-voltage substations, backup UPS, overhead lighting, circuit breakers.

issueTypes.name: HVAC & Climate Control
issueTypes.description: Chillers, central air handling units, AHU air ducts, lab climate monitoring, coolant lines.

issueTypes.name: Plumbing & Hydraulic Infrastructure
issueTypes.description: Treated water network, overhead distribution tanks, RO purification, laboratory drainage, sanitary lines.

issueTypes.name: Structural & Architectural Maintenance
issueTypes.description: Building envelope, masonry, waterproofing, ceiling leakage, double-glazed window sashes, expansion joints.

issueTypes.name: Elevators & Vertical Conveyance
issueTypes.description: Traction passenger lifts, freight elevators, emergency interlock controllers, door sensory curtains.

issueTypes.name: Network Infrastructure & IoT
issueTypes.description: Optical fiber riser backbones, PoE distribution switches, smart campus sensors, environmental telemetry.

issueTypes.name: Fire Protection & Life Safety
issueTypes.description: Addressable smoke detectors, dry powder extinguishers, wet riser valves, illuminated evacuation paths.

issueTypes.name: Other / Miscellaneous
issueTypes.description: General campus facility defects, custom repairs, laboratory fixtures, and manual miscellaneous issues.

tickets.title: Server Room 302 Chiller Auxiliary Compressor Trip
tickets.description: The secondary compressor in the 3rd floor server room tripped with error E-44 (Thermal Overload). Room ambient temperature elevated from 19Ã‚Â°C to 27.5Ã‚Â°C within 40 minutes.
tickets.manager_notes: Technician team dispatched. Freon leak suspected on circuit 2. Compressor replacement on order.

status_history.comment: Initial incident report logged via FIXIT mobile portal.

tickets.title: Hydraulic Risers Main Valve Water Ingress
tickets.description: Underground conduit flange connection leaking into basement cable trench near distribution switchgear. Sump pumps actively handling 15 liters/min.
tickets.manager_notes: Gasket replacement scheduled tonight during low-consumption maintenance window (01:00 - 04:00).

status_history.comment: Identified during morning routine lab equipment check.

tickets.title: Phase 3 Harmonic Surge on Laser Spectroscopy Sub-panel
tickets.description: Voltage fluctuation exceeding 18% on Phase 3 causing intermittent resets on high-precision optical bench instrumentation. Neutral return showing 42V offset.
tickets.manager_notes: Power quality analyzer installed on substation tap. Testing grounding rod impedance.

tickets.title: Passenger Lift L-02 Micro-Switch Interlock Seizure
tickets.description: Door optical curtain repeatedly fails to cycle, holding cab stationary at Level 2 with alarm buzzer active. Safeties engaged.
tickets.manager_notes: Schindler vendor technician replaced optical transceiver and recalibrated door closing torque. Load tested with 800kg deadweight.

status_history.comment: Reported by staff on morning opening.
Vendor verified safe for operation. Ready for user verification.

tickets.title: Reading Hall East Wing Linear LED Array Flicker
tickets.description: Continuous 100Hz stroboscopic flickering on luminaires L-12 through L-24 causing eye strain for 80+ student cubicles.
tickets.manager_notes: Failed DALI dimming driver unit replaced. Light meter reads steady 480 lux across all desks.

status_history.comment: Flickering started during evening study session.
Inspected and confirmed lighting is uniform and quiet. Excellent work!

tickets.title: Solar Water Heater Heat-Exchanger Valve Burst
tickets.description: Rooftop collector loop 3 losing hot water down external facade drain pipe. Pressure relief valve stuck in open bypass mode.
tickets.manager_notes: Temporary manual isolation valve turned off. Replacement temperature-pressure relief valve requisitioned.

status_history.comment: Water steam seen discharging over western parapet.
